releaseNotes:
IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR EXISTING USERS (v1.51.0 & older):
We have upgraded GIZTV to a permanent signing key for 1-click future updates!

To update to v1.52.0:
1. Uninstall your current GIZTV app once.
2. Download & install v1.52.0.

All future updates will then auto-install seamlessly!

New Features in v1.52.0:
• Coil 3 Image Loader
• ExoPlayer Episode Pre-queueing
• Custom Subtitles (.vtt / .srt)
• Digital Audio Passthrough (AC-3 / Atmos)
